name: Mikura Jinbee
source: Masayuki's grandfather who used to be a womanizer when he was younger. Loves challenges, and used to be a full-time gambler through which he made the Mikura family a wealthy one.
translation: Masayuki's grandfather who used to be a womanizer when he was younger. Loves challenges, and used to be a full-time gambler through which he made the Mikura family a wealthy one.
